name: commerce-agents/demo-overlay
description: Floating 'Agentic Commerce demo' launcher inside the in-browser Shopware storefront and administration: opens the shopping assistant and the merchant portal of the demo shell and shows boot progress. Twig block extensions + inline JS, no theme build.

description.en-GB: Launcher for the in-browser Shopware x Claude Commerce Agents demo (shopping assistant, merchant agent, boot progress).
description.de-DE: Launcher für die In-Browser-Demo Shopware x Claude Commerce Agents (Shopping-Assistent, Händler-Agent, Boot-Fortschritt).
